title: ordering.order-paid v1
description: An order was paid; fulfillment starts on it. Consumers must ignore properties they do not know: adding one is a backward-compatible change.

eventId.description: Unique per occurrence; the message-id consumers deduplicate on.

aggregateVersion.description: Version of the aggregate after the change; detects gaps and reordering.

customerId.description: The account that owns the order.
